sports.detail: All three ATP 250 signed supervisor draws (Almaty 9410, Lyon 496, Brussels 7485) and both WTA signed draws (Ningbo 2092, Osaka 405) were read this session. Every one shows the Round of 32 fully scored, and the ATP Live Race confirms the surviving players 'will play next in the R16'. Round of 16 pairings are not printed in those documents, so there is no upcoming tennis fixture that can be sourced. OLBG nevertheless lists 21 of these completed Round of 32 ties as 'Tomorrow'.

NBA (2 games on 22 October) and EuroLeague Round 7 (5 games) verified. Korea KBL Mobis Phoebus v Changwon Sakers and Brazil NBB Fortaleza BC v Pinheiros are listed upstream but no official league page was read for either, so both are unverified and unpriced.

Bermuda Championship, Stifel Charity Classic and Senior Italian Open verified as events from PGA TOUR / Legends Tour pages. The Stella Artois Players Championship (Sunshine Tour) could not be read on an official Sunshine Tour page and is unverified. No outrights priced: no published entry list.

Sri Lanka v England and New Zealand v India verified and priced. Namibia v Ireland and Australia Women v New Zealand Women verified as fixtures but with no sourced rating on both sides, so unpriced. The two CSA Pro T20 cards and Afghanistan v Zimbabwe are unverified.
All eight Round 3 ties read on the official WST match centre. OLBG lists only two of the eight upstream - a coverage gap on OLBG's side, not ours.

Three fixtures verified on LNR pages, each with LNR's own published three-way probabilities. The seven remaining Pro D2 round 8 fixtures, Gallagher Premiership round 4 and the four URC round 4 fixtures could not be confirmed on an official fixture page this session; URC standings were read but the round 4 fixture list was not.

Four RLWC2026 Round 2 fixtures verified on the official IRL site. OLBG's rugby league hub publishes no World Cup match card at all on 22 October - only 2027 outrights. No official ranking pair or complete Round 1 result set was read, so no price is originated (rule 4).

World Series games 1-3 verified on the MLB Stats API with both clubs' full 2026 records from the standings API. OLBG lists only Game 1 and prints a 20:00 clock for a game the API schedules at 00:00Z on 24 October (8pm ET on 23 October).

The complete 12-game NHL slate for 22 October verified on the league schedule API with arenas, plus all 32 clubs' records from the standings API. OLBG's ice hockey hub shows three SHL games and one Liiga game and its NHL sub-route returns 'No tips found', so none of the 12 NHL games is listed upstream. The four OLBG-listed European games could not be verified on shl.se or liiga.fi this session.
United States Grand Prix verified as Round 18 with full circuit data and the Singapore result. Win-race market not priced: no entry list or qualifying order published.

All 16 European Championship Round One ties verified across the official schedule, field-and-draw and preview releases, with Order of Merit money and the two most recent European Tour result sets. Three ties carry no printed seed numbers and are flagged.

The two EHF Champions League matches on 22 October verified on the official playing-times PDF. The 16 domestic and EHF European League cards listed upstream could not be read on a federation page this session and are unverified.

PGE GiEK Skra Belchatow v PGE Projekt Warszawa on Saturday 24 October verified on the Polish league site. The men's PlusLiga URL now serves the women's TAURON Liga site, and the same fixture appears with both an 18:00 and a 12:00 clock on that site, so the kick-off is left blank and nothing is priced. The five Czech Extraliga cards and the three remaining Polish cards are unverified.

OLBG's eSports hub returns 'No tips found'. LoL Worlds 2026 structure, seeded tiers and Play-In results verified on the official LoL Esports site; Swiss pairings are drawn on 23 October so no head-to-head market exists yet.

Five county finals verified on Munster GAA, Cork GAA, Waterford GAA, Limerick GAA and the Maigh Cuilinn club site, each with semi-final scores. The All-Ireland 2027 outright listed upstream has no official source and is unverified.
OLBG's greyhound hub returns 'No tips found' on 22 October. gbgb.org.uk was not reachable to confirm or deny a racecard, so coverage is recorded as zero from OLBG and unconfirmed from GBGB.
